pages.title: Drowned Girl
pages.text: §lRace:§r Undead.$(br)§lAllegiance:§r Friendly. She never attacks players or villagers unprovoked, and only turns against kin that have sunk into bloodlust; she and Zombie Girls will never harm one another.$(br)They are not alone. In the freezing depths of rivers and seas, they followed each other's faint presence and gathered into a small band.$(br)§lPotions:§r Unlike ordinary undead — healing potions mend her wounds, and harming potions hurt her as normal.$(br)§lHabits:§r She is not purged on peaceful difficulty, and she does not burn in daylight. You may meet her in rivers and oceans by day or night, though she is more common at night and in deep water.

pages.title: A Waking Nightmare
pages.text: They are undead like the drowned and skeletons, yet they loathe their own kind — loathe those walking corpses that sank into bloodlust and became pure monsters.$(br)They know full well that they, too, are monsters. But they had no help from any outside force. By nothing more than their own lingering will, they nailed their consciousness fast inside these waterlogged husks. Even the ceaseless scouring of the current could not wash away that last shred of clarity — it flickers at times, like a candle in the wind, but it has never truly gone out.$(br2)When someone raises a weapon against them, they do not fight back. To them, death is not an end but a release — release from this body that is already a candle guttering in the wind. What they do not know is that somewhere in the Tome of the End, a page has been torn free: «Take nine parts dawn-dew and golden light, and condense them into a single star...» Perhaps what is written there is another possibility.
